dedupe_keys.name: tz sam solar asset mapper global satellite derived inventory of utility scale solar farms with capacity and construction dates transitionzero

description: The Solar Asset Mapper from TransitionZero is a global, satellite-derived dataset of utility-scale solar farms produced by combining machine learning with human annotation. The Q1 2024 release on Zenodo contains the location and outline of 63,616 assets in 183 countries, covering more than 19,100 square kilometres with an estimated total capacity of 711 GW, and estimates construction dates for over 80 percent of them. It ships six files: analysis-ready polygons as GeoPackage and as CSV with centroid coordinates and country, an Excel version, a sources table linking each asset to the raw geometries, the raw polygons, and a preprint explaining the method. Each asset carries an identifier, geometry, estimated capacity in MW, and upper and lower bounds on construction date derived from the imagery in which it first appears built or under construction. The files are available for free download under CC BY-NC 4.0, and the record was last updated in January 2025; TransitionZero also hosts a polygon browser. Coverage is global. Caveats: the licence bars commercial use, capacities are modelled from area, the dataset merges other known solar farm geometries, and the TransitionZero site blocked automated reading on the day. Simulation uses are solar farm locations, sizes and ages for exposure analysis and capacity studies. Related records: data-global-renewables-watch-solar-wind and data-harmonised-global-wind-solar-farm-locations-osm are alternative global inventories.
